A teacher says that after exercise, the fitness of a person determines the time taken for their pulse
rate to return to normal. A fit person’s pulse returns to normal in a shorter time.

• a brief description of your method
• how you would measure pulse rate

• how you would use your results to draw a conclusion

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why the background radiation count is measured three times.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Procedure
• The teacher places the detector 20 cm away from the radioactive source of β-particles.
• She switches on the counter, measures the initial count rate and records it in Table 7.1.
• She places a sheet of very thin aluminium foil between the detector and the source.
• She measures the new count rate and records it in Table 7.1.
• She adds a second sheet of aluminium foil.
• She measures and records the count rate in Table 7.1.
• She repeats this procedure until 6 sheets of foil are added.
Table 7.1
number of sheets of foil measured count rate actual count rate from source
added counts / minute counts / minute
(N)
0 632 600
1 456 424
2 384
3 322 290
4 272 240
5 227
6 190 158
The actual count rate from the source can be found by using the equation shown.
actual count rate from source = measured count rate – average background count rate
Record, in Table 7.1, the missing values of the actual count rate from the source.
